subject: Consolidated renewal window: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Confluence migration sync
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: github-sales@github.com, contracts@jetbrains.com, atlassian-ps@atlassian.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated renewal window: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Confluence migration sync

Hi all —

We have an opportunity to synchronize our renewals and a planned Confluence data model migration to reduce churn and risk across the developer org. Current state: GitHub Enterprise renewal on 2026-11-30, JetBrains licenses annual renew 2026-12-15, Confluence data export/migration window we’d like to schedule in late Nov.

Goal: align contract effective dates where possible (Nov–Dec window) so we can:
- Negotiate multi-vendor pricing leverage or timing-based discounts
- Reduce admin overhead for SSO/KM rotation during the Confluence migration
- Schedule minimal developer impact for license changes/read-only windows

Attached is a simple renewal matrix (2026-08-21_devtools_renewal_matrix.xlsx) with seat counts, SKUs, and current POs. I’m asking for:
- Vendor reps: rough timeline for finalizing quotes if we target Nov 15–Dec 15 effective dates
- Internal: Laura and Dev, can you validate seat counts and any upcoming hiring that will change quantities by >10%?

If there’s any appetite for coordinating payment terms (NET 30 vs NET 45) or committing to 12 vs 24 month terms for better unit price, flag it here — we can take a single commercial ask to finance.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: 2026-08-21_devtools_renewal_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: contracts@jetbrains.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal window: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Confluence migration sync

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the note and the matrix. Quick answers:
- We can hold current list prices for renewals executed by 2026-11-30; if you want to move to a 24-month term we can offer a 9% discount off list.
- JetBrains needs a firm seat list by 2026-10-20 to lock the price and avoid proration mismatch.

I attached quote_v3 for a 12-mo and 24-mo option (jetbrains_quote_v3.pdf). On the Confluence migration: no technical blockers from our side for the timelines you proposed, but if accounts are being consolidated or usernames change we recommend letting us coordinate with your SSO admin during the migration week to avoid license reassignment churn.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, JetBrains
mateo.alvarez@jetbrains.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal window: GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, Confluence migration sync

Jonas —

I pulled the seat numbers and hiring delta: current JetBrains active seats = 420, expected hires through Dec = +18 engineers (already accounted in hiring funnel). GitHub Enterprise seats = 540; we’re underutilized by ~8% from last quarter but we should keep headroom for Q1 ramp. Confluence migration window: DevOps team suggests a 48-hour read-only for a full export during Thanksgiving week (Nov 25–27); that aligns with minimal dev activity.

Action items I’ll take:
- Finalize JetBrains seat delta by 2026-10-15 and send to Mateo
- Confirm GitHub license terms with the GitHub rep and request proration options if we shift effective dates
- Draft a short migration runbook for the Confluence export to share with vendors and SSO (will link in Drive)

If finance is open to a 24-month term to capture the 9% JetBrains discount, I think it’s worth modeling.

Laura Bennett
Director, IT Procurement
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the consolidation plan. We can align the GitHub Enterprise renewal to match a Nov 30 effective date; two notes:

2) If you commit to a 12-month term executed by 2026-11-15 we can include a developer enablement workshop (2 hrs) and a $10k implementation credit toward SSO/testing during your Confluence migration.

Suggested next steps:
- Laura: confirm final seat counts by 2026-10-20 (matches JetBrains deadline)
- Finance: confirm NET terms preference (I’ve seen requests for NET 45 for cash flow)
- Jonas / DevOps: upload runbook link when ready so we can schedule the enablement workshop the week prior to migration

Happy to set a 30-min sync with vendor reps and procurement — propose Wed 2026-09-08 10:00 PT.

Best,
